Backend Software Engineer (Mid-Level) — Platform Team

About the role:
We're looking for a mid-level backend engineer to join our Platform team building the
services that power our core product. You'll work across our API layer, background
job processing, and data infrastructure, partnering closely with frontend and ML
engineers to ship reliable, well-tested features.

Responsibilities:
- Design, build, and maintain RESTful APIs and background workers that handle
  asynchronous processing at scale.
- Write clean, well-tested Python code, with an emphasis on correctness and
  maintainability over cleverness.
- Work with relational databases (PostgreSQL) to design efficient schemas and
  queries, including migrations for evolving data models.
- Integrate with third-party APIs and internal services, handling authentication,
  rate limiting, and error recovery robustly.
- Participate in code review and help maintain CI/CD pipelines.
- Collaborate with product and design to translate requirements into technical
  designs.

Required qualifications:
- 2+ years of professional experience building backend services in Python or a
  similar language.
- Experience with a modern web framework (FastAPI, Django, or Flask).
- Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL.
- Experience with containerization (Docker) and basic CI/CD workflows.
- Familiarity with asynchronous task queues (Celery, Dramatiq, or similar).
- Strong written communication and ability to work independently.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with PostgreSQL extensions (e.g. pgvector) or vector search concepts.
- Experience integrating with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic) in production systems.
- Familiarity with TypeScript/React on the frontend side.
- Experience with OAuth-based third-party integrations (e.g. GitHub, Google).
- Exposure to observability tooling (structured logging, tracing, error reporting).

We're a small, remote-friendly team that values pragmatic engineering, clear writing,
and shipping things that work end-to-end over speculative architecture.
